author: dmaretskyi
principle: Reuse a common/shared type for a recurring cross-cutting concept (e.g. an actor/author field) instead of an ad hoc string field.
fix_shape: replace the ad hoc field with the shared common type

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not add a field duplicating something the platform's object metadata already provides (e.g. tags on ECHO object meta).
fix_shape: remove the redundant field and use the platform-provided one

author: dmaretskyi
principle: An operation input that identifies an existing object should take a typed Ref rather than a bare id string.
fix_shape: change the input field's type to a Ref instead of a string id

author: dmaretskyi
principle: A setter function must not call the object's own batched-update primitive internally; let the caller wrap multiple field writes in one update call themselves.
fix_shape: remove the internal update()/batch wrapper from the setter and let callers do the wrapping

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Place an object-mutation API in the namespace that owns objects, not a more general entity namespace that also covers relations and types.
fix_shape: move the functions into the more specific owning namespace

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Perform bulk background data-processing (like deduplication merges) in the worker/host process that owns the data rather than synchronously on the client.
fix_shape: move the batch operation into the worker/host path instead of a client-side pass

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not query or scan an entire space/collection when a narrower targeted query can serve the same need; a full scan is a performance pitfall.
fix_shape: replace the full-space scan with a filtered/targeted query

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Document the precise meaning and lifecycle of a durable state row (what creates it, what clears it, what its presence implies) directly in the comment rather than leaving it to be inferred.
fix_shape: add the explicit lifecycle explanation to the comment

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Name a directory/module to match what it actually exports — a capitalized name implies a public namespace-export module, so a plain re-export helper should be lowercase and live under a common/internal location.
fix_shape: rename the directory to lowercase and move it under the common/internal location

author: dmaretskyi
principle: A consuming package should not reach into another package's internal module; either move the logic into the package that needs it or expose a public API for it.
fix_shape: relocate the code so it no longer needs the internal import, or add a public API entry point

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Add logging for a significant success path (a state-changing operation like a merge), not only for failures.
fix_shape: add log statements recording what changed (e.g. ids merged/removed) on the success path

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Test a distributed convergence property (like a merge across replicating peers) with an actual multi-peer integration test, not only single-peer unit tests.
fix_shape: add a two-peer replication test that demonstrates the system settling to the converged state

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Question whether an explicit client-triggered operation is still needed once an automatic background mechanism already covers the same job.
fix_shape: remove the explicit pass if the automatic path already achieves the same result, or justify why both are needed

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not introduce a new interface/abstraction layer over an existing concrete class when a small, narrowly-scoped new class can do the new thing on its own.
fix_shape: leave the existing class unchanged and add a focused new class for the new behavior instead of generalizing behind an interface

author: dmaretskyi
principle: A deferred callback (like an alarm/timer handler) should not inherit the calling fiber's context; give it a context owned by its own scheduler so contexts do not grow unbounded through recursive scheduling chains.
fix_shape: fork the callback with a fresh/owned context rather than the caller's inherited one

author: dmaretskyi
principle: A public application-facing interface should not import types straight from the wire/protocol layer, and should take an options object rather than positional parameters.
fix_shape: define local option types instead of depending on protocol wire types directly in the signature

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not build a façade/adapter that hides a distinction (e.g. local vs remote execution) that consuming code actually needs to be aware of to behave correctly.
fix_shape: remove the adapter and have callers branch explicitly on the distinction it was hiding

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not call a deprecated function; remove the call and adjust the surrounding logic rather than keep relying on it.
fix_shape: remove the deprecated call and its now-unneeded branch

author: wittjosiah
principle: A diagram that encodes meaning through color must include a legend explaining what each color represents.
fix_shape: add a legend to the diagram

author: wittjosiah
principle: Name a concept after what it generally is, not after its first or most common use case, so the name still fits as usage broadens.
fix_shape: rename the concept to something that covers its full range of uses

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Represent a new kind of completion event using the existing message/content-block shape (e.g. a synthetic text block) rather than inventing a new event type for it.
fix_shape: wrap the payload as the existing block/message type instead of adding a new event kind

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Avoid a global mutable registry for per-object bookkeeping when a more local mechanism (e.g. a hidden property on the object itself) can serve the same purpose.
fix_shape: store the data on the object instead of a global map, and drop unneeded dispatch abstraction

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not reintroduce an abstraction (like dispatch through a mutable handler slot) that was deliberately removed for simplicity or performance.
fix_shape: keep the simplified fixed-handler design rather than re-adding dispatch indirection

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Keep package.json export-condition keys consistent across every package (e.g. always map `import` to the build default) rather than varying the convention per package.
fix_shape: align the export condition key/order to match the repo-wide convention

author: dmaretskyi
principle: After replacing a mechanism, scan for and remove the now-dead code from the superseded approach rather than leaving it alongside the replacement.
fix_shape: delete the leftover dead code the refactor made obsolete

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Include the enclosing scope's id (e.g. spaceId) as a leading column in an index/key meant to be unique or queried only within that scope, to avoid cross-scope collisions.
fix_shape: add the scope id as the first column of the composite index

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Keep an implementation-internal capability (like arming a process's own alarm) off the public handle/API; do not expose internal scheduling mechanics to external callers.
fix_shape: remove the public method and keep the capability internal to the owning component

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not maintain two parallel context-propagation mechanisms (a custom Context object and Effect's own context); use Effect's context exclusively once Effect is adopted.
fix_shape: pass the value through Effect's context instead of a separate Context parameter

author: wittjosiah
principle: Do not put application-specific behavior (e.g. an app's login-page helper) in a shared SDK/config package; keep it in the app that needs it.
fix_shape: move the helper into the consuming app's own package

author: wittjosiah
principle: When an architecture change removes the need for a config field/message, remove it entirely as part of the same change rather than leaving it in place unused.
fix_shape: delete the now-unnecessary config message/field

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not store on each record data that can be derived by a resolver from its other fields (e.g. an endpoint derivable from provider + id); derive it instead of hand-populating a redundant field.
fix_shape: remove the extra field and compute it via a resolver lookup keyed on the existing fields

author: wittjosiah
principle: Schedule a timeout through the codebase's context-aware scheduling helper rather than a raw setTimeout, so it is automatically cancelled when the owning context disposes.
fix_shape: replace the raw setTimeout with the ctx-scoped scheduler helper
